source.author: 芜香芋
observations: Displayed ordinary profession tickets cost4 ingots in the observed pages; this is a display quote, not an unconditional tariff.
Purchasing opens recruitment. Recruit choices and confirmations occur before the shop resumes.
At87:10 held corn quotes70,46,46,46,28; at87:35 quotes79,55,55,55,37. The formal roster rises44 to47.
At87:30 a displayed sniper recruit decision has a zero-hope reserve choice.
The later F6 and final multi-ending score are excluded from first-ending comparisons.

implementation_scope: One already offered ordinary shop service ticket, actually purchased from a live unsold slot, grants one finite reserve opportunity.
No profession frequencies, character identity, promotion or extra shop slots are inferred.
Each successful actual recruit uses the existing corn+3 callback. Buying, menu opening, retention, decline and refresh do not grow corn.
Retained ordinary tickets are usable only at FINAL under the existing three-slot storage rule.
Existing shop layout, slot occurrence, price and refresh priors stay unchanged and unverified where previously marked.
Variant includes separately verified per-entry bank costs; current student weights and release pointer are not changed.
This repairs a previously documented missing mechanism; it is not evidence of student training progress.
